# Night passage

Sailing through the night needs a watch system, navigation lights and a plan for the dark. Identify other vessels by their lights and follow the [[Collision rules]]. Keep the [[VHF radio]] on channel 16.

## Watch system

Two crew alternate three hour watches; the off watch sleeps in a lee cloth below. Clip on to a jackstay whenever you leave the cockpit.

## Navigation lights

A red light marks port and green starboard; a white light astern. A masthead tricolour saves power on a small sailing boat.
